message: Ah, the joys of a sudden blackout! I remember those times when the kids would panic, thinking the sky was falling, while I calmly gathered some candles and snacks. Having a plan for power outages can really help turn a scary situation into an adventure. If you're looking for some helpful tips to keep your family calm and collected when the lights go out, I found a great resource that lays it all out. How do your kids handle a blackout? Any fun stories to share?
